root_cause.text: In the error path of add_adev(), after auxiliary_device_uninit() frees the containing struct mana_adev (via adev_release()), the code still accesses adev->id (a field of the freed structure) to free the allocated index, causing a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message says "Since adev is embedded in struct mana_adev, the subsequent fall-through to init_fail and access to adev->id may result in a use-after-free." The patch saves the auxiliary device ID into a local variable before calling auxiliary_device_add() and uses that local variable in the cleanup path after auxiliary_device_uninit() to avoid accessing the freed structure.
